text:
mira: quick sync — Kestrel Health onboarding today at 10:30PT. Need to lock SLA/SLO language and reporting cadence before the enablement call. renewal flag: low but early signals from finance asking about credits.

jared: got it. do we have the latest latency percentiles from their pilot? i remember a few p90 blips last week.

sam: yes — attached in the dashboard but tl;dr: p50 < 80ms, p90 ~ 420ms during 03/12 14:00-15:00 window (spike tied to a bad routing rule). overall uptime 99.97% for the trial.

ana: (cc @mira @jared) customer asked for two things: 1) weekly SLO digest email, 2) a clear credit calc example if we miss p99 latency target.

mira: thanks. propose we set formal SLOs for onboarding phase: uptime >= 99.95 monthly, p90 latency <= 250ms, p99 latency <= 750ms. weekly digest to comms inbox + monthly SLA report. thoughts? :thinking_face:

jared: those look reasonable. p90 250ms is a bit aggressive given model size — can we promise that on Dedicated? Kestrel is on Hosted for now.

evan: quick note from eng: Hosted baseline with current routing/quantization should meet p90 250ms for short prompts but long-context jobs will push p90. recommend we scope SLO to "interactive requests" (<= 750 tokens). would be clearer.

sam: agree with evan. also suggest we add a fallback policy entry: "If latency > SLO due to model variant, automatic fallback to smaller model within 3 minutes" — helps reduce credit exposure.

mira: ok new draft SLOs in chat: ```
SLO (onboarding 0-90d):
- Uptime >= 99.95% monthly
- p90 latency (interactive <=750 tokens) <= 250ms
- p99 latency (interactive <=750 tokens) <= 750ms
- Reporting: weekly digest (Mon), monthly SLA PDF to procurement
- Credit policy: single-month breach -> pro-rata credit; 3-month rolling breaches -> renewal review
```

ana: can we add an example credit calc? procurement will want the math.

jared: simple example: monthly invoice $12,000. uptime target 99.95%. if uptime observed 99.85% (0.10% short), credit = invoice * (short / target?) maybe we use our standard: credit = invoice * (downtime_seconds / seconds_in_month) * weighting. i'll pull exact formula from playbook.

mira: copy. action items: 1) jared pull & paste exact credit formula; 2) sam update routing fallback policy; 3) evan confirm token/size scoping text; 4) ana schedule enablement + send digest template to Kestrel. i'll own sending the draft SLOs to the customer after we finalize wording.

ana: scheduled: enablement 3/25 10:30PT. i'll invite product enablement too.

sam: small ops ask: can we add an alert runbook for p90 regressions so we don't get surprised? quick playbook: Pager -> page on sustained p90 > 300ms for 5m, otherwise cs-alert for 1h spikes.

evan: will add scoping note: "SLO applies to interactive routes only (routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat.stream). Batch/embeddings excluded."

jared: paste of credit calc from playbook: ```
# credit calc (simplified)
downtime_ratio = downtime_seconds / seconds_in_billing_cycle
credit = invoice_amount * downtime_ratio
# adjustments: apply SLA weighting, minimum threshold of 5 minutes
```

mira: perfect. last thing — feedback capture: please add a single checkbox to the onboarding survey: "Are SLA expectations clear?" with options: yes / no (please explain). we'll use that to surface risk ahead of renewal.

ana: will add to invite and pre-call survey.

deploy-bot: SLO dashboard update deployed to staging at 5100001278.

mira: thanks — will review post-deploy and then send the draft to Kestrel. will report back after the enablement call. :thumbsup:
